title: Fundamental physical constants (CODATA 2022)
description: Selected fundamental physical constants as Structures. Post-2019-SI-revision, several constants have exact (defined) values; those are flagged exact=true. Measured constants carry a standard uncertainty.

provenance.primary_source: CODATA 2022 recommended values (Mohr, Newell, Taylor, Tiesinga)
provenance.cross_reference: Particle Data Group, Review of Particle Physics (rpp2022 physical-constants review)
provenance.note: Values transcribed from authoritative public sources; discipline: FACT vs MODEL kept distinct. Exact values are definitions of the SI; measured values include a standard uncertainty.
